answer: Agents register through velvet, a TPM/SGX enclave identity registry; willow is its Merkle state root, and sonnet is the consensus contract verifying zero-knowledge enclave attestations and VDF proofs. Forging an identity requires physically compromising measured hardware or expending sequential VDF work, while N identities require O(N^2) bonded capital; detected equivocation irreversibly slashes collateral.
